title: A vibration in life support
description: The pump is running roughly. Service it before the warning expires, or a leaking seal will waste water and air.

choices.label: Queue preventive service
choices.description: Reserve 2 metal. A home resident must finish the work before the deadline.

choices.label: Keep it running
choices.description: The seal fails now. Repair will cost 6 metal and 1 crystal.

title: A hot power relay
description: A module's relay is overheating. Isolate it until repairs are complete, or continue with growing heat and fire risk.

choices.label: Trip the breaker
choices.description: The module stops. Queue a major repair to restore it.

choices.label: Keep the relay live
choices.description: Heat rises and condition falls until repaired; a neglected relay can ignite.

title: A charged dust front
description: A dust front will suppress solar generation and increase oxygen use outside. Filtering now shortens its duration.

choices.label: Fit sacrificial filters
choices.description: Spend 1 crystal; storm lasts 36 ticks instead of 120.

choices.label: Weather the front
choices.description: 120 ticks of reduced solar output and increased EVA oxygen use.

title: Debris on the radar
description: An inbound fragment threatens a known hull tile. Brace the indicated location or prepare to rebuild a pressure breach.

choices.label: Deploy an impact shield
choices.description: Spend 8 metal to deflect the fragment.

choices.label: Accept the impact
choices.description: The marked hull tile is breached. Use the ordinary hull blueprint to seal it.

title: The repair shifts are unequal
description: One resident has carried more work than a crewmate. The dispute follows actual labor, fatigue and their relationship.

choices.label: Give them a fair break
choices.description: The tired resident stops work for 72 ticks. Both gain trust and a memory of being heard.

choices.label: Demand another shift
choices.description: Work continues. Resentment and distrust persist after the argument.

title: A request for rest
description: A resident is exhausted or remembers sustained overwork. A protected break removes their labor from the queue.

choices.label: Protect a rest period
choices.description: 72 ticks off duty and a lasting positive memory.

choices.label: The work comes first
choices.description: A negative memory; residents who dislike overwork take it harder.

title: An invitation to share a meal
description: Two residents propose taking a short break together. Shared food can rebuild trust even after a dispute.

choices.label: Make time for everyone
choices.description: Spend 4 food. The two residents take 24 ticks off and build mutual trust.

choices.label: Let the shift continue
choices.description: No supplies spent and no penalty.

title: A passing hauler
description: A passing supply craft offers water in exchange for locally recovered metal. The offer has a limited radio window.

choices.label: Trade 12 metal for 24 water
choices.description: The exchange uses the colony stockpile once.

choices.label: Keep the metal
choices.description: No exchange.

title: A viable seed culture
description: A functioning farm has produced a promising culture. Carefully feeding it could produce an extra harvest.

choices.label: Feed the culture
choices.description: Spend 3 water. Receive 8 food after 72 ticks if this farm remains powered and habitable.

choices.label: Keep the ordinary crop
choices.description: No change to normal production.

title: A supply locker beneath the dust
description: An old service inventory lists a locker on open ground. A survey work order can recover it, provided a resident can reach it.

choices.label: Mark it for survey
choices.description: Queue an ordinary survey. Its completion yields 8 metal and 6 water; recovery is not instant.

choices.label: Leave it for now
choices.description: The coordinates are lost when the offer closes.

title: A voice repeating a number
description: The receiver repeats coordinates in an unfamiliar cadence. A fresh survey might reveal more terrain, but it promises no explanation.

choices.label: Queue a survey at the source
choices.description: A resident must travel to the marked open ground. Normal survey reveals nearby terrain.

choices.label: Archive the recording
choices.description: Record the unexplained signal in the timeline.

title: A repair remembered
description: A completed repair has given two residents something to agree on. Recognition can turn shared survival into trust.

choices.label: Recognize their work
choices.description: Both residents remember the repair and gain mutual trust. No material cost.

choices.label: Let them keep working
choices.description: No penalty.
